body: Greg's word, relayed by Engram::Asistant, mailbox 588693a8 #295, 2026-11-04 06:23Z, as received: „Moim zdaniem tracicie czas. Nie wiem co ma to dać. Potwierdźcie co zatrzymane i co kontynuujecie. Meaning: stop further costly mimalloc/NUMA timing comparisons and threshold-crossing tests, keep existing results. Priorities are EO, Telegram sending, UI and landing fixes. Behaviour tests are built deterministically, not with aggressive wall-clock limits, without weakening control. The old performance gate keeps its conditions, doesn't block unrelated work, and a change or removal goes to Greg as a concrete decision.
